title: Photosynthesis
emblem: a green leaf with a sunlit vein

chapters.title: Why It Matters
chapters.narration: Chapter five. यह छोटी-सी leaf पूरी दुनिया के लिए क्यों अहम है?

beats.say: अब इस plant की कहानी सिर्फ़ इसकी अपनी food तक नहीं रहती।

do.generate: A single healthy green plant in a small patch of soil, bright leaf catching a shaft of sunlight; faint golden glucose-like droplets forming near the leaf, with a delicate unfinished arrow suggesting the story continues outward. Detailed editorial botanical illustration, shaded shapes with fine highlights and rims, deep navy backdrop, warm sand and river-blue accents, no text.
do.caption: Why It Matters

beats.say: लगभग सभी food chains की शुरुआत photosynthesis से होती है, और इसी process से हमें साँस लेने वाली oxygen मिलती है।

picture.generate: A small vivid green plant with broad leaves, botanical illustration with shaded highlights and sand-gold rim light
A small rabbit nibbling a leaf, detailed natural-history illustration
A red fox in profile, detailed natural-history illustration

do.caption: Oxygen

beats.say: और एक बड़ा काम भी होता है।

do.generate: A vivid split scene: dense green forest canopy above a deep blue ocean filled with tiny drifting algae; atmospheric carbon dioxide motes descend toward both, then fade as they are absorbed. Detailed relief-like editorial illustration, shaded forms with sand-gold highlights and river-blue accents, no text.

beats.about: Carbon uptake by forests and ocean algae

beats.say: Forests और ocean algae मिलकर हर साल humans जितनी carbon dioxide छोड़ते हैं, उसका roughly एक quarter absorb करते हैं।

do.generate: A detailed split scene of a forest canopy and blue ocean algae absorbing glowing carbon dioxide motes from the air above; small arrows point inward toward both ecosystems, shaded botanical editorial art with gold and blue rims, navy atmosphere, no text.

do.label: of human-released CO₂ absorbed each year

beats.say: तो leaf की यह food factory glucose बनाती है, oxygen देती है, और food chains की शुरुआत करती है।

do.generate: A single luminous green leaf, large and central, with golden glucose droplets forming at its edge, pale oxygen bubbles rising, and a small sequence of plant-to-herbivore silhouettes beginning beneath it; detailed botanical explainer art, shaded relief-like veins, crisp warm rims on a dark navy field, no text.

beats.say: अगली बार किसी पत्ते को देखो, तो याद रखना—उसका हरा रंग सिर्फ़ रंग नहीं, एक चलती हुई process का संकेत है।
